fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 6% of Total Sales or $600/month per territory; the $600 minimum is waived during the first 12 months of operation (if in compliance). For Conversion Franchises, royalty is 2% of Total Sales for months 1-12, 4% for months 13-24, and 6% thereafter; the $600 monthly minimum is waived for the first 24 months. Brand Development Fund Contribution is the greater of 2% of Total Sales or $300/month per territory; minimum waived for Conversion Franchises per same schedule implied. Technology Fee is $500/month per business unit (contiguous territories counted as one business unit); may be changed on 30 days' notice, increases not anticipated to exceed 20% annually. Customer Service Support Fee is the lesser of $400 or 2% of Total Sales, monthly. Market Cooperative Contribution is 1%-5% of Total Sales as determined by the cooperative; currently none. Local Advertising Requirement is the greater of 2% of Total Sales, $1,500/month, or $0.0375 per Qualified Household per territory — not paid to franchisor but to vendors, shortfall may be remitted to franchisor. Minimum Performance Standard (MPS) applies: minimum annual Total Sales are $80,000 (Year 1), $120,000 (Year 2), $150,000 (Year 3+); shortfall royalty equals 6% of the difference between actual and minimum Total Sales.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | The greater of 6% of Total Sales or $600 per month (whichever is greater) for each territory, subject to any annual Shortfall Royalty Payment due on the annual Minimum Performance Standard ("MPS"). | Monthly, on the last business day of the following month | See Notes 1, 2, 3 and 4. The $600 per month minimum is waived during your first 12 months of operation, provided you are in compliance under the franchise agreement. For a Conversion Franchise, (i) the Royalty Fee is 2% of Total Sales for the first 12 months of operation as a Bloomin Blinds franchise, 4% of Total Sales for months 13-24 and 6% of Total Sales after 24 months and thereafter, and (ii) the $600 monthly minimum is waived for the first 24 months.
Brand Development Fund Contribution | You must contribute 2% of Total Sales or $300 per month (whichever is greater), for each territory. | Monthly, on the last business day of the following month | See Notes 1, 2, and 3.
Technology Fee | Currently, $500 per month per business unit (for purposes of the Technology Fee only, any of your contiguous territories are considered to be one business unit). | Monthly, on the last business day of the following month | We charge this fee for certain software and other technology products and services we provide. The Technology Fee will not necessarily be a pass-through of our exact costs. We may add, remove, or alter the software or technology products or services that we provide, and we may change the amount of this fee on 30-days' notice. Any increase to the Technology Fee will reflect an increase in the actual costs we incur to collect and invoice customers on your behalf, but we do not anticipate the fee to increase by more than 20% annually.
Customer Service Support Fee | Currently, the lesser of (i) $400, or (ii) 2% of Total Sales. | Monthly, on the last business day of the following month | This fee pays for our Customer Service Center, which provides services for handling communications with potential and existing customers, plus the per call cost. We may change the fee on 30-days' notice. Any increase will reflect an increase in the actual costs we incur with our Customer Service Center, but we do not anticipate the fee to increase by more than 5% annually.
Market Cooperative Contribution | 1%-5% of Total Sales, as determined by the cooperative. Currently, none. | Monthly, on the last business day of the following month | See Note 5.
Local Advertising Requirement | For each of your Territories, you must spend at least the greater of: (i) 2% of total sales; (ii) $1,500 per month; or (iii) $0.0375 per Qualified Household on marketing your business. | Per vendor |
